products.notes: Broad-spectrum systemic turf insecticide. Turf label rate range is 6.4-12.8 oz/acre, with pest-specific rates. Apply in 1-5 gal water/1,000 sq ft and follow with enough irrigation or rainfall to move the active ingredient through the thatch. Do not exceed 12.8 oz product/acre/year (0.4 lb clothianidin a.i./acre/year). Observe pollinator restrictions and keep children and pets off treated areas until dry.
